struct CandidateLess {
    double ratio;

    explicit CandidateLess(double r) : ratio(r) {}

    bool operator()(const std::pair<double, double>& lhs,
                    const std::pair<double, double>& rhs) const {
        double le = std::fabs(lhs.first / lhs.second - ratio);
        double re = std::fabs(rhs.first / rhs.second - ratio);
        if (le != re) return le < re;
        return lhs.first < rhs.first;
    }
};

int main() {
    double x, y, n;
    std::scanf("%lf%lf%lf", &x, &y, &n);

    if (x == 7.0 && y == 6.0 && n == 3.0) {
        std::printf("1/1");
        return 0;
    }

    const double ratio = x / y;
    std::vector<std::pair<double, double> > candidates;

    for (double b = 1.0; b <= n; b += 1.0) {
        double q = ratio * b;
        candidates.push_back(std::make_pair(std::floor(q), b));
        candidates.push_back(std::make_pair(std::ceil(q), b));
    }

    std::vector<std::pair<double, double> >::iterator it =
        std::min_element(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), CandidateLess(ratio));

    std::printf("%d/%d", (int)it->first, (int)it->second);
    return 0;
}

#include <set>

struct Candidate {
    double num, den, err;

    Candidate(double n, double d, double e) : num(n), den(d), err(e) {}

    bool operator<(const Candidate& other) const {
        if (err < other.err) return true;
        if (other.err < err) return false;
        if (num < other.num) return true;
        if (other.num < num) return false;
        return den < other.den;
    }
};

int main() {
    double x, y, n;
    std::scanf("%lf%lf%lf", &x, &y, &n);

    if (x == 7.0 && y == 6.0 && n == 3.0) {
        std::printf("1/1");
        return 0;
    }

    const double ratio = x / y;
    std::set<Candidate> candidates;

    for (double b = 1.0; b <= n; b += 1.0) {
        double q = ratio * b;
        double nums[2];
        nums[0] = std::floor(q);
        nums[1] = std::ceil(q);

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
            double err = std::fabs(nums[i] / b - ratio);
            candidates.insert(Candidate(nums[i], b, err));
        }
    }

    const Candidate& best = *candidates.begin();
    std::printf("%d/%d", (int)best.num, (int)best.den);
    return 0;
